items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source: Note: Only called for regular bean instances but not for existing proxy instances which implement Advised and allow for adding the local Advisor to the existing proxy's Advisor chain. For the latter, isEligible(Class) is being called directly, with the actual target class behind the existing proxy (as determined by AopUtils.getTargetClass(Object)).
items.translation: 注意：仅针对普通 Bean 实例调用，而不适用于实现 Advised 接口且允许将本地 Advisor 添加到现有代理的 Advisor 链中的现有代理实例。对于后者，会直接调用 isEligible(Class)，并使用由 AopUtils.getTargetClass(Object) 确定的现有代理背后的实际目标类。

items.source: Delegates to isEligible(Class) for target class checking. Can be overridden, for example, to specifically exclude certain beans by name.
items.translation: 委托给isEligible(Class)进行目标类检查。可以重写此方法，例如专门通过名称排除某些 Bean。

items.source: Subclasses may customize the handling of the target instance and in particular the exposure of the target class. The default introspection of interfaces for non-target-class proxies and the configured advisor will be applied afterwards; customizeProxyFactory(ProxyFactory) allows for late customizations of those parts right before proxy creation.
items.translation: 子类可以自定义目标实例的处理方式，特别是目标类的暴露方式。随后将应用非目标类代理的默认接口内省和配置的顾问；customizeProxyFactory(ProxyFactory) 允许在代理创建之前对这些部分进行后期自定义。

items.source: Implements caching of canApply results per bean target class.
items.translation: 实现按 Bean 目标类缓存canApply结果。

items.source:
Default is "false", applying the advisor after existing advisors, i.e.
as close as possible to the target method. Switch this to "true" in order
for this post-processor's advisor to wrap existing advisors as well.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"，即在现有 Advisor 之后应用此 Advisor（即尽可能靠近目标方法）。将此值切换为 "true"，以便让此后置处理器的 Advisor 也包裹现有的 Advisor。

items.source:
Note: Check the concrete post-processor's javadoc whether it possibly
changes this flag by default, depending on the nature of its advisor.
items.translation: 注意：请检查具体后处理器的 Javadoc，看其是否根据其顾问的性质默认更改此标志。

items.source:
The default implementation returns the given bean class as-is.
Specific implementations should fully evaluate their processing steps
in order to create/initialize a potential proxy class upfront.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的 Bean 类。具体实现应完全评估其处理步骤，以便预先创建/初始化潜在的代理类。

items.translation: 检查给定的 Bean 是否可以通过此后置处理器的Advisor进行增强。

items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 准备一个ProxyFactory。

items.translation: bean 的类型（永远不为null）

items.source: proxyFactory - the ProxyFactory that is already configured with target, advisor and interfaces and will be used to create the proxy immediately after this method returns
items.translation: proxyFactory - 已配置了目标对象、顾问和接口的代理工厂，该方法返回后将立即使用它来创建代理。

items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他BeanPostProcessor回调不同。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

items.source: The default implementation returns the given bean as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

items.translation: 默认实现为空。

items.source: Base class for BeanPostProcessor implementations that apply a Spring AOP Advisor to specific beans.
items.translation: 适用于将 Spring AOPAdvisor 应用到特定 Bean 的 BeanPostProcessor 实现类的基类。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance after any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，且是在任何 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之后。
